intro: This archive collects 12 articles tagged `espionage` published between April 12, 2026 and May 16, 2026, giving security teams a focused view of how this topic has appeared across ZCyberNews coverage. Observed actor references include APT28 (Fancy Bear), APT37, and Deep#Door, presented only where the underlying article metadata supports the attribution. The affected-scope signals emphasize government, defense, and healthcare across Europe, South korea, and Southeast asia, helping readers compare exposure patterns without adding claims beyond the archive data.
